Bloub SVG avatar engine
Source: https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub
Revision: b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Only framework-free src/bot modules are included, transpiled with TypeScript.
Upstream animation constants and expressions are unchanged.
Regenerate: node tools/vendor-bloub.mjs <path-to-installed-bloub>

TREKBROSS supplies its own round orange body, black eyes, draggable UI and interaction mapping.
